About this Event

🎃 BellaPuppies Halloween Puppy Yoga Pawty 🐾👻
Get ready for the cutest Halloween celebration ever! Join BellaPuppies for a special Halloween Puppy Yoga Pawty filled with adorable puppies, yoga, cuddles, costumes, photos, and plenty of Halloween fun.
Our puppies will be dressed in their cutest Halloween costumes—and you’re encouraged to dress up too! 🧙🏽‍♀️🎃👻
Your $65 ticket includes 1 hour and 15 minutes of Puppy Yoga & Play Time, giving you plenty of time to stretch, relax, cuddle, take pictures, and enjoy the puppies.
🐾 What to Expect
Puppy YogaPuppy Play & Cuddle TimeCostumed Puppies 🎃Halloween Photo Opportunities 📸Best Costume Prizes 🏆Treats & RefreshmentsHalloween music, décor & good vibes 💕📅 Saturday, October 31st
Session Times:10:00 AM • 12:00 PM • 1:30 PM • 3:00 PM
🎟️ Tickets: $65 per personIncludes 1 hour & 15 minutes of Puppy Yoga & Play Time
📍 BellaPuppies 53-55 Main Street Hackensack, NJ 07601
📞 (646) 722-6772
Come dressed up, bring your best energy, and get ready for a Halloween experience filled with puppy kisses, cuddles & unforgettable memories! 🐶💕🎃
